hkp.text: Treatment and cost plan (German: Heil- und Kostenplan): the cost estimate for larger treatment. The patient accepts or declines it before treatment starts.

recall.text: The reminder for the next check-up or cleaning, usually every 6 months.

pzr.text: Professional tooth cleaning. Patients with statutory insurance usually pay for it themselves.

gkv.text: GKV = statutory health insurance, PKV = private health insurance. Self-pay patients pay for treatment directly.

lab.text: The practice's own dental lab. Work made there stays in the practice as revenue.
